lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a regular grid pattern posterior to the gills. Three primary spots form a vertical column with roughly equidistant spacing, mirrored by a secondary column further posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, forming a checkerboard-like grid where the spots serve as high-intensity nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal carina is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
